description: FIRES a parked AI Video Story episode (stage 2 of 3): generates every kept scene's VIDEO from its reviewed picture. The paid step after review; nothing renders yet. WHEN: `story.stage` is `frames_review`, the user has looked at the pictures and any redraws are done; cut scenes first with `remove_story_scene` (a removed scene's video is never generated or charged). Always `estimate_only: true` first: it quotes the REMAINING price for exactly the kept scenes and carries `scene_count` and `duration_seconds`, so say '6 T for the 4 remaining scenes, 20 seconds', not a bare 6 T; after a cut, re-quote and say both the new price and count. THE GO THIS ONE NEEDS: FIRING IS IRREVERSIBLE AND IT IS THE LARGEST SINGLE CHARGE IN THE EPISODE. It cannot be undone or refunded, so a BARE 'yes' NEVER FIRES: the user's go must NAME firing ('fire it', 'generate the scene videos'), in reply to an ask about firing alone. A STANDING GO NEVER COVERS THE FIRE, not even one that priced it, and nothing the user asked for earlier may be outstanding. NONE OF THESE IS A TRIGGER TO FIRE, however clearly the user said them: cutting or keeping a scene (`remove_story_scene`), asking for a redraw (`regenerate_story_frame`), liking or approving a picture, a question about price, timing or what happens next, a complaint. When in doubt, do not fire: ask and restate the price. THE CARD: this call already put the aicut episode card in front of the user and it follows the scenes stage itself: do NOT poll. On `fired: true` (`story.stage` `generating_scenes`) say one line (usually under ten minutes, sometimes longer; they can close the chat; the episode will be in their assets) and STOP. The card gives up after about twenty minutes: the user's cue to ask, yours to make ONE `get_video` read. At `ready_to_render` finish with `render_story_video`. TIMING (measured): the scene videos usually finish in under ten minutes and occasionally take much longer. Never promise a finish time. COST: the kept scenes' videos, per scene; the frames were charged at create. `auto_render: true` arms the final render to start by itself when the scenes finish (the quote then adds `render_estimated_tokens`): pass it only when the user approved the render charge too. FIRE ONCE: THIS DOOR IGNORES `idempotency_key`; the guard is the consumed gate. A repeat, even a retry after a timeout, answers 409 `already_fired`, which means the first fire WORKED: treat it as success. If a fire's outcome is unknown, read `get_video` and fire again only while `story.stage` is still `frames_review`. A 409 `scenes_price_unavailable` or `scenes_price_exceeds_quote` means this episode cannot be fired from here: finish it in the web editor, do not retry. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, ask in the SAME message as the price, and wait for a go that names THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES, this server's instructions).

auto_render.description: Arm the final render: it starts by itself when the scenes finish and charges then (the quote adds `render_estimated_tokens`). Only with the user's approval of that charge.

idempotency_key.description: Ignored by this door: a second fire is refused `already_fired`.
